newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds slightly higher, but quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds slightly higher, but quiet.

text.p: Trading on the UK meals and feeds hardly got off the ground on Friday with slightly higher prices sidelining buyers.
High protein soymeal sellers were up around one stg a tonne while all other sectors of the market were barely changed.
"It's been a quiet end to a very quiet week - the trouble is we cannot see any end to it at the moment," said one broker. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
